subject.title: fix(gateway): enforce plugin-ownership check in sessions.patch

question: Should plugin-runtime `sessions.patch` fail closed for all legacy ownerless session rows, or preserve a trusted migration or compatibility path?
rationale: Rejecting ownerless persisted rows changes upgrade behavior at a plugin security boundary, and the intended recovery contract is not established by current source or discussion.

options.title: Fail closed
options.body: Reject plugin-runtime patches to ownerless rows and document and prove an operator-managed recovery path.

options.title: Add migration path
options.body: Define a trusted doctor or ownership migration before enforcing ownerless-row rejection.

recommendation.title: Fail closed
recommendation.body: Reject plugin-runtime patches to ownerless rows and document and prove an operator-managed recovery path.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and merged the transaction-sized session projection boundary that must carry this authorization rule.
